description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Create a new ticket type.

attributes.description: Ticket-type attributes. `displayName` (string), `active` (optional, defaults to true), `faceValue` (number in MAJOR units: 39.50 means thirty-nine fifty, and the CLI converts it to the minor units the API stores), `maxInventory` (integer, the number of tickets for sale, required), `quantityIncrement` (optional, defaults to 1), `maxQuantity`, `salesStart`, `salesEnd`. The API drops a key it does not know, so a misspelling goes through and does nothing.

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

title: Create ticket
